A study tells one piece of research from start to finish: the question, the campaigns that answered it, and what came out. Every number in a study is the judge's measurement or a measurement named with its scope, every win is one the judge confirmed, and each study ends with what has not been measured yet.

## Share yours

Ran a campaign worth telling? Bring its numbers to the [Hackers in the Loop Discord](https://discord.gg/3Qs2uejUf9). [Use cases](../use-cases/index.mdx) shows where Thermite fits, if you are still choosing a first project.
